annotations.title: List the chapters of a customs tariff section

description: List the chapters (two-digit codes) of one section of the Algerian customs tariff with their titles, for example the chapters of section XVI. Use it after customs_tariff_sections. The same for the Tunisian tariff with country TN (French titles; needs an API key) and for Morocco with country MA (harmonized system 2022, French titles; needs an API key). This dataset holds no duty rates and no tariff lines below the chapter level.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

section.description: Section of the customs tariff in capital Roman numerals, for example XVI. Find the sections with customs_tariff_sections.

name: customs_tariff_chapters
title: List the chapters of a customs tariff section
